lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical white lines. Spacing is broader in the mid-torso region and increasingly compressed towards the posterior haunch.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The two vertical lines closest to the posterior terminate mid-flank, transitioning into a pattern of discrete spots.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 8 high-contrast white spots is visible on the lower haunch and upper hind limb region.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three spots on the mid-haunch align horizontally to form a broken geometric line segment.

other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive white crescent-shaped patch at the base of the neck and prominent white spots on the lateral facial region below the eye and on the cheek.
